description: Browse or search the FBI National Stolen Art File — stolen and missing artworks under active FBI art theft investigations. Returns artwork UIDs, titles, descriptions, maker/artist, materials, measurements, period, and a thumbnail image URL. Filter by title or maker substring. Use page to paginate. Pass a UID into get_art_crime for the full record.

maker.description: Filter by artist/maker substring (e.g., a painter or publisher).

title.description: Filter by title substring (e.g., a work or object name).

name: list_art_crimes
title: List Art Crimes
